skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 130% ATK (+10) damage to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 20% ATK (+2) damage to all enemies in a 5-hit combo. The first hit has a 50% chance to inflict [Collapse] on the target for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 25% ATK (+2) damage to all enemies in a 5-hit combo. The first hit has a 50% chance to inflict [Collapse] on the target for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently grants self (+20) HP. After an Armament-type ally attacks, Atomic Samurai immediately performs a [Follow-up] (attacks with 80% of his basic attack's damage and effects, up to 3 times per turn).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently grants self (+20) HP. After an Armament-type ally attacks, Atomic Samurai immediately performs a [Follow-up] (attacks with 120% of his basic attack's damage and effects, up to 3 times per turn).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently grants self (+20) HP. After an Armament-type ally attacks, Atomic Samurai immediately performs a [Follow-up] (attacks with 130% of his basic attack's damage and effects, up to 3 times per turn).

effects.desc: Extra attack outside of turn. Disabled by [Lock] and [Blind].
